evidence:
Walked instruction.md and /instructions/hireops_rules.md line by line against the frozen reference (paths under .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r7/task/). Every asked-for screen, role and flow has an implementation:
- Views: staff get Board, Conversations, Activity (public/js/app.js:87-91 buildViews); candidates get 'My applications' list with job title, team and candidate-wording status plus each conversation (threads.js:27,52-53,139; index.js:171-176 uses SEED candidate_status_labels, all six labels match hireops_rules.md section 7).
- Sign-in/roles: session-cookie identity, 401/403, candidate 404 for others' applications (index.js:68-81,121-131,326-333,378-385); all 10 brief accounts present in seed with matching roles; password Hireops!2026 (db.js:63).
- Jobs/candidates: recruiter opens job (title, team, HM chosen from HM accounts, places 1-50) index.js:202-214, board.js:61-81; add candidate to bottom of Applied, email format + case-insensitive per-job duplicate refused at the field keeping typed values, candidate-account linking (index.js:216-233; board.js:47-56).
- Board moves: one stage at a time, reject needs reason & remembers from-stage, reopen only to that stage, Hired cannot be rejected (index.js:238-265); ordinary controls (select+Move, Up/Down) plus optional drag (board.js:208-243,300-319); in-stage order shared and persisted via position column; Interview places with reorder-inside always allowed (index.js:290-295); HM limited to own job and Interview/Offer/Hired (index.js:257-264, board.js:144-162); observer/candidate move nothing.
- Concurrency: per-card version, stale move 409 naming who via last activity line (index.js:241-245); optimistic move shown at once, put back with reason and focus kept on the card's controls (board.js:166-205).
- Bulk all-or-none in board order with whole-set Interview count (index.js:274-321, 339-344; board.js:285-290); Undo of own latest single/bulk move, restores stage/place/reason, refused if any card changed or Interview would overfill, single-use, superseded by a later move (index.js:165-168,348-373).
- Internal notes: open card shows details and notes; recruiter any, HM own jobs, observer read; unsaved note kept per person per browser (index.js:386-398; board.js:85-141, localStorage key prefixed by user id app.js:39-43).
- Activity: job opened, added, moved, rejected (with reason), reopened, reordered, undone; newest first; All jobs or one job filter; refused actions log nothing (transactions) (index.js:195-198,211,230,266-271,315,366,189; app.js:45-85).
- Live updates: SSE 'changed' after every successful write + BroadcastChannel relay, keyed in-place DOM patching that preserves open card, note draft, focus, scroll (index.js:45-54,102-107; app.js:130-164; board.js:321-341; threads.js:36-65,145-159).
- Conversations: latest 30 oldest-first scrolled to newest, earlier 30 at a time with remaining count, scroll anchor preserved (index.js:401-417; threads.js:110-131,160-175); arrival while scrolled up keeps place and shows 'N new messages', unread until viewed; draft/cursor untouched (threads.js:145-159); per-person unread and total badge (index.js:132-139; app.js:115-121; threads.js:221); seen receipt on sender's latest message with observer excluded (index.js:143-150; threads.js:76-83); Enter sends, Shift+Enter newline, box cleared and refocused, failed send stays with message (threads.js:183-201); line breaks kept (styles.css:105 white-space: pre-wrap); per-conversation per-user drafts survive switch/reload/session loss and are invisible to other sign-ins (threads.js:112,124,182; app.js:34,189-195); candidate sign-in does not open a conversation (threads.js:7).
- Runtime: node /app/server.js, PORT honoured, 0.0.0.0, /api/health answered before DB work (bootstrap.js:18-24,43), DB_PATH honoured (db.js:9), seed bundled beside module (src/seed_data.json sha256 a1c65c80... identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json), seed once (db.js:61-62), UI and API from one process.
Corroboration: raw-evidence-index.json hashes verified against current frozen bytes (all 6 artifacts and all 12 matching_source_files match). results/workspace.json reports 25/25 scripted golden groups passed with no page errors, covering board rules, roles, undo/bulk, live board (arrival_ms 805), conversation paging/scroll/drafts, session loss, observer read-only, candidate privacy and restart persistence. This is scripted golden evidence, not a configured judge run, Oracle score or model score; none is claimed.
Adversarial notes: a plausibly broken app (e.g. no undo or no Activity filter) would be a solution/criteria problem for other rows, not this one; here every capability the brief asks for has code and most have run observations. A conforming alternative (polling instead of SSE, different routes/labels) is explicitly allowed by the brief and app_context.md and does not bear on reference coverage. No asked-for capability lacks an implementation. Minor latent observations (not defects for this row): no polling fallback if the SSE stream is blocked (reconnects every 3 s; measured arrival 805 ms); the 'who' in a stale refusal comes from the card's latest activity line, which is always written for every version-changing action.
